author: donotreviv3
body:
Because it's just the next progression of your class line. You gain other benefits like lvl 2 of your pets bestial bond bonuses, and an extra 5% pet ai you didn't previously have. Not to mention the extra skills you gain like skadi(pet focuses more on attacking) and flare 2 which definitely packs a punch at that level.

Keep carrying on, you'll notice a nice bonus to your pets damage in t8 at freyr class. Just keep and eye out for the important event pets once you get to t8 and you'll be mostly laughing right up to t10 t11.

body: Because having a pet do the damage while you defensively/offensively buff yourself is awesome. And currently at the end of the game is a very viable build

author: arusinoff
body:
Because of the passives, that will make your follower much stronger.

You will need different followers for different situations and encounters. 

I would recommend to start collecting gear with ward. So you will have a restorable buffer between you and death :)
